headline: Health Data Analyst
skills: Healthcare data analysis (admissions, length of stay, PhilHealth claims)
summary: Health data analyst with three years in hospital billing and records. I combine admission, billing and discharge data to show managers where claims are returned or delayed, and I understand the clinical and coding terms behind the numbers. I want to build stronger analysis tools for hospital operations.

experience.title: Health Data Analyst
bullets: Analyse admission and discharge data for a 150-bed hospital and report monthly length-of-stay and occupancy trends.
Track returned PhilHealth claims by reason and ward; fixing the top three causes cut returns by about a third.
Check that diagnoses in the billing data match the chart documentation before monthly submission.
Prepare Excel charts for the medical director's quarterly review.

experience.title: Medical Billing Clerk
bullets: Prepared patient statements and insurance claims, and resolved coding questions with the attending physicians.
Kept a log of rejected claims and their reasons, which later became the basis of my hospital reporting.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Information Systems
